scope: FIRST independent review of three final n117 figures against the three current original PNGs, retained figure context, and independently checked 3D mathematics.

labelRepair.independentComparison: Compared each preserved first-render spec with its final spec. Only text-object positions changed: one label in 250 and four labels each in 251/252. All non-label objects, source context, canvas, display, assertions, and layout remain deeply equal. No 3D geometry or scientific relation changed.

method.pixelComparison: Opened each original individually, then each final bitmap individually. Compared apparatus roles, poles, field strokes, loop, support, all current/normal/force marks and their readable directions. Unclear overprinted source directions were not supplied from the candidate or from the author computation.
method.hashAndMapAudit: Read-only assertions checked each current source/spec/SVG/render/bitmap hash, all inventory object/assertion references, unique IDs, and connects coverage for every semantic arrow. Render metadata binds the current spec and SVG. Each spec's complete authoritative text matches the retained figure context.
method.mathAudit: Independently recomputed normal = transverse cross vertical, normal dot both plane basis vectors, normal dot B, the right/left segment current cross B signs, equal/opposite force sum, force-pair torque, and normal cross B. Independently projected every loop corner, current endpoint, force endpoint and normal endpoint into the final spec, and checked the suspension endpoint and continuity.
method.svgAudit: Parsed the three existing SVGs as XML without rendering. Each has viewBox 0 0 640 520 and exactly N, S, I, I, F, F, n, B as its eight text labels, all at 32px. No external image, script, foreignObject, numeric angle or extra displayed equation is present.
method.repairHistory: First-render spec and render-FAIL files remain hash-bound and were read as technical history, not as approval. No first-failed bitmap was opened.
method.technicalDiagnostic: The first read-only audit compared the authoritativeText array with a string and stopped. The corrected check used its lesson/text record and passed without editing or rerendering any candidate.
method.approvalBasis: Independent pixels, source-role completeness, actual current/normal/force signs, and recomputed 3D relations. Machine render PASS alone is not approval.

sharedMathematicalAudit.basisConvention: B = +x; vertical = +z; transverse t = (a,b,0); right-side current = +z and left-side current = -z; current-selected normal n = t cross z = (b,-a,0). These are disclosed modern construction coordinates, not source-given data.
sharedMathematicalAudit.forceSigns: Right current cross B = +y and left current cross B = -y. Both plotted F arrows implement these signs. The two indicated F roles are retained; other conductor portions are not declared force-free.
sharedMathematicalAudit.torque: For the normalized opposite lever positions +/-t and forces +/-y, force-pair torque = 2a*z, consistent in sign and orientation with n cross B = a*z. The normalization is internal audit data, not a new lesson formula or measured torque.
sharedMathematicalAudit.closedLoop: The closed planar loop's full force sum cancels in the stated uniform external field. Top/bottom conductor forces also cancel; in 250 their directions are outward along +/-z, consistent with expansion. No zero-force conclusion for nonuniform external fields is used.

orientationChecks.meaning: Stable parallel normal; loop plane perpendicular to B; zero torque.
Oblique normal; nonzero torque opposed by symbolic elastic torsion. No source angle is inferred.
B is in the loop plane; normal perpendicular to B; maximum torque for unchanged I, area and B.

sharedMathematicalAudit.projectionTerminologyNote: The disclosed map has rows (105,46,0) and (0,62,105), whose dot product is 2852, so it is a general linear schematic projection, not a strict metric orthographic-camera projection despite the author's 'orthographic' wording. The actual map is disclosed and agrees with every audited endpoint. No screen-space perpendicularity, numerical source angle or metric inference is used; this naming caveat does not alter the verified physical relations.

sharedVisualAudit.finalBitmapContent: All three final bitmaps are nonblank and preserve a left N pole, right S pole, closed single loop, top suspension, seven explicitly representative field strokes, opposed I arrows, two opposed F arrows, one n arrow and one modern B arrow from N toward S.
sharedVisualAudit.culture: PASS: only English/symbol labels; no Cyrillic, Chinese, old-book texture, decorative cultural symbols, handwriting, or invented scene identity.
sharedVisualAudit.support: Straight untwisted support for 250 and symbolic twisted support for 251/252 attach to the top loop region. No calibrated spring constant, measured twist, battery, lead circuit, hidden junction or actuator is inferred.
sharedVisualAudit.fontAudit: Existing render reports say 16.55px at width 331, 16.7px at 334, 17.9px at 358, and 32px at 640. XML independently verifies 32px canvas labels; 32*331/640 = 16.55. No new width screenshot or product screen-transform check was performed.

figures.independentOriginalInventory: One left N block and right S outline; one narrow tall inclined quadrilateral loop; vertical suspension; horizontal gap-field family; two I marks in crowded upper/lower central loop regions; one clearly rightward n arrow; upper-right F arrow pointing up/right and lower-left F arrow pointing down/left. No numerical given angle, magnitude, dimensions or resolved electrical lead circuit.
figures.sourceInventoryMapAudit: All eight inventory groups map to existing objects/assertions. Poles, loop, support, field family, both I roles, both F roles and normal role are present. Added B and regularized projection/placements are explicitly separated from source facts. Direction certification for the overprinted I marks remains incomplete.
observations: Final repaired bitmap was independently inspected, including the relocated right I label. Eight labels and all arrowheads are visible without observed clipping or label/stroke collision.
B and current-selected n point the same way. The physical loop plane is perpendicular to B; opposing segment forces are outward and collinear in the stable case, so net torque vanishes.

The original rightward n and the two F directions are resolved. The crowded upper/lower I strokes cannot be associated unambiguously with specific source wire arrows from these current pixels. The candidate's clean right-up/left-down assignment is mathematically coherent but is not an independent reading of those unresolved source arrowheads.

authorHoldDisposition.disposition: RESOLVED by this first independent final-bitmap inspection; the historical author-uninspected statement remains unchanged.

observations: Final source-role inventory is complete: both poles, all I/F/n roles, loop and suspension are retained. The final n arrow remains diagonally down/right while the modern B arrow runs rightward from N toward S.
The 3D normal is perpendicular to the loop plane but oblique to B. The force pair gives nonzero torque with the same sign as n cross B; symbolic support torsion supplies the stated balance.
The internal (0.6,0.8) basis is an arbitrary normalized layout choice, not a source-given angle. No numerical angle, force magnitude, measured twist or added equation appears in the bitmap or SVG.

All eight final labels are distinct and readable at the inspected canvas size. The normal label is separated below its arrow rather than touching it; the sole unlabelled internal vector is identifiable as n. No clipping or collision was observed.
figures.reason: PASS for the current figure's independently verified source roles, readable directions, disclosed modernization, current-selected normal, force signs, oblique torque balance and final bitmap. This is not native course/display approval or promotion.

figures.sourceInventoryMapAudit: All eight inventory groups resolve and all source roles are represented. The source n/current direction requirements are not certified merely because the final map has a coherent right-hand convention.
observations: The original two F arrowheads and pole roles are readable. The source's n shaft/current marks meet heavy loop/field/force strokes; the n arrowhead and exact current-arrow associations do not resolve confidently enough to certify their directed source meanings.

The final right-up and left-down current assignment gives n = -y. In the audited physical plane spanned by x and z, B = +x lies in the plane and n dot B = 0, so the magnetic torque magnitude is maximal. The projected diagonal n is not required to be screen-perpendicular to the horizontal B.

Both indicated forces and their signs are retained; no force is deleted and no conductor portion is declared force-free. Final labels, arrows, loop and support are visible without observed clipping or collision.
The modern RHR convention is fully disclosed and internally correct. It cannot resolve unclear source arrowheads by itself or prove exact source current/normal directions.
